lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's six hundred sixty-eight? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 668? Nope!

lines.text: Round down x, two x and three x, and add. How many totals from one to one thousand?
lines.caption: Round down x, 2x and 3x, and add. How many totals from 1 to 1000?

lines.text: From zero to one, the total goes zero, one, two, three.
lines.caption: From 0 to 1, the total goes 0, 1, 2, 3.

lines.text: At one, all three floors jump at once. Three leaps to six!
lines.caption: At 1, all 3 floors jump at once. 3 leaps to 6!

lines.text: Four and five get skipped, in every block of six.
lines.caption: 4 and 5 get skipped, in every block of 6.

lines.text: One thousand leaves remainder four. So it's out, too!
lines.caption: 1000 leaves remainder 4. So it's out, too!

lines.text: So three hundred thirty-three are skipped. Six hundred sixty-seven are left!
lines.caption: So 333 are skipped. 667 are left!

lines.text: Six hundred sixty-eight was the trap.
lines.caption: 668 was the trap.

lines.text: Did you get six hundred sixty-seven? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 667? Tell me below!
